configFile.description: Micro-Manager hardware configuration (.cfg) loaded when the hub starts (system-config mode). '~' is expanded; a relative name is looked up in the working directory, then in the first adapter path. Omit it to load devices one by one from the device entries (inline mode).

adapterPaths.description: Folders searched for device adapter libraries. Empty uses the MICROMANAGER_PATH environment variable, then the Micro-Manager install found by pymmcore-plus (which falls back to the mm-test-adapters demo adapters).

circularBufferMB.description: Size of MMCore's circular image buffer in MB. null keeps MMCore's own default.

logDir.description: Folder that receives MMCore's own log file. null leaves MMCore's logging where pymmcore-plus puts it.

adoptExistingCore.description: Reuse the process-wide CMMCorePlus another package created instead of constructing a private one. Only for setups that share a core with napari-micromanager or similar; the core's signal backend is then not under ImSwitch2's control.
